notes.title: Update of the first chapter. Chapter completed.
notes.content:
We are the Grebot Games team, and have recently completed a major demo and chapter 1 update for our novel Cold Harvest.

For everyone who has already completed the previously released version, we recommend that you go through the first chapter again, as the changes affected the plot, new scenes were added and a lot of work was done on the bugs. Unfortunately, saves from the old version of the game cannot be used in the current version.

In the future, such changes are not planned for the first chapter and the demo, as we have made all the planned changes and are now actively engaged in the creation of the second and subsequent chapters. But still, since the project is in early access and is actively developed, adjustments and bugs are possible until the release of the game.

We thank everyone who has already played and actively participates in the development of the project.

notes.title: The reaction of anti-virus programs to the launch of the Cold Harvest game.
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Some players have encountered an issue where their antivirus software and firewalls report "suspicious" network activity when launching the game bCold Harvest/b.

We want to assure you that everything is fine and the game does not do anything illegal. The network activity is related to the software we use to develop bCold Harvest/b.

In this update, we have minimized the game's network activity as much as possible. However, it will be difficult to completely eliminate such cases, as the game will eventually implement cloud saving of progress and achievement tracking.

It is also worth noting that Valve takes moderation and virus checking of game distributions very seriously. The distribution of infected game distributions is practically impossible on the Steam network.

If you encounter a similar situation in the future, please let us know through any convenient means. Thank you and have a pleasant game.
